title: Rollout policy API & SDK: traffic safety, idempotency, and permission controls
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a first-class API surface and SDK helpers to manage canary rollouts, A/B experiments, shadow traffic, and automated rollback policies. This ticket covers: 1) REST endpoints and gRPC equivalents for creating/updating rollouts; 2) SDK client helpers (Node/Python/Go) that implement safe defaults (idempotent create, backoff on conflicts); 3) permission model for who can create, promote, pause, or abort rollouts; 4) explicit controls for shadow traffic and A/B splits; 5) payloads to define auto-rollback conditions tied to metrics (latency, error rate, eval regressions); 6) audit/logging hooks for traceability required by Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: API: POST /rollouts and PATCH /rollouts/:id accept rollout spec with traffic plan, schedule, and rollback rules
SDK: helper function startRollout(rolloutSpec, { idempotencyKey }) that retries safely and surfaces meaningful error codes
Permissions: RBAC roles documented; only users with rollout.create can start canaries, rollout.promote can change traffic allocations, rollout.abort can stop and rollback
Traffic features: support percentage-based canaries, weighted A/B buckets, and a shadow=true toggle that mirrors requests without counting toward metrics
Auto-rollback: rule language supports threshold comparisons e.g., "error_rate > 2% for 3m" and ties to an alert action that pauses and demotes to previous model
Observability: each rollout event emits audit entries with initiator, idempotency key, plan diff, and resulting traffic state
Idempotency: server honors an idempotency key for create/update operations for at least 24h and returns same resource when replayed
tasks: Write API spec draft (endpoints, payload schemas, HTTP status codes) - PM/Eng collab
Prototype SDK helper in Node with idempotency token support and exponential backoff
Design RBAC matrix and map to console actions & API scopes
Define rollback rule DSL and map to existing metrics/alerts in Console
Add audit fields to rollout event model and wire to logging pipeline
Engineering: implement server-side idempotency store with TTL and collision handling
QA: end-to-end tests for canary ramp, shadowing, A/B split correctness, and auto-rollback scenarios
